title: Cost-aware routes in an authorized observed graph
description: Compute the minimum summed nonnegative integer edge cost from one to 64 generation-fenced roots. Costs must be usable source-qualified facts on every selected edge, including unreachable edges. Direction is outgoing by default or incoming. Omitted or empty targets return the complete shortest-path forest; explicit targets return only those routes and their exact paths. Results describe this projection, not native walkability, resource feasibility or complete-world absence. Full source, work, wall and complete output budgets apply; no truncation, effect or authority is created. Runtime also checks UTF-8 byte lengths, u64 IDs and duplicate endpoint IDs.
